contribution_types.description:
Just completed 45 minutes of FaceTime with Prithvi from Nzatu where we discussed 

- The African cacao situation

- western coast is controlled by the cacao board which is basically the government and is hard to deal 

- East coast in Tanzania, Uganda and Madagascar is where the single origin small family farms are (1-2 hectares of land)

Follow ups

- Explore replicating the model pioneered in Brazil first in Uganda, then later to Tanzania and Madagascar 

- speak to the farmers to figure out who is onboard 

- identify the processing facility 

- identify the exporting entity 

- start with 100kg payload 

- converted to ceremonial bars in bags of 200 grams bags 

- FDA approval for the Uganda exporting company 

- Come up with storyline for the farms in the region
